title: Appointment of challengers and party representatives
paragraphs: A. The county chairman of each party may designate, for each precinct or location, by written appointment addressed to the election board, a party agent or representative and alternates for a polling place in the precinct and at any voting center, including an in-person early voting location and an emergency voting location, who may act as challengers for the party which appointed him.
B. At each voting place, one challenger for each political party may be present and act, but a challenger may not enter a voting booth except to mark his ballot.

C. Not more than the number of party representatives for each party that were mutually agreed on by each political party represented on the ballot shall be in the voting place at one time. If such agreement cannot be reached, the number of representatives shall be limited to one in the voting place at one time for each political party.
D. A challenger or party representative shall be a resident of this state and registered to vote in this state.
